thread:
maria: Compliance requested a one-click export for 'who changed routing policies' but mapping to real users must be admin-only. Can we design guardrails?
jeff: We need quotas and concurrency limits for exports. Large exports spike IO and affect SLOs.
sam: Proposal: separate export_quota + job circuit-breaker for jobs >30m. Queue jobs and return job id.
ana: ana: Security note: never include emails by default. Default = hashed actor id + actor_hint (team/role).
security-bot: Recommend hashed ids in main export; provide a separate mapping artifact encrypted with KMS and auditable access logs. Short TTL presigned links.
maria: Console UX: add toggle "Actor details: none | hashed | mapped (admin only)". If mapped requires 2nd-factor and extra approval.
jeff: API sketch: POST /v1/audit/exports { range, filters, actor_mode: "none|hashed|mapped" } -> 202 { job_id, estimated_count }.
sam: Backend: stream NDJSON with fields: ts,event,policy_version,actor,actor_hint,diff,auth_proof_ref. Sign the file and deliver via KMS-protected presign.
audit-bot: Export queued (job=exp_2845678901) ETA ~90s for ~25k events.
maria: Quick NDJSON sample lines: `{"ts":"2026-03-20T15:00:00Z","event":"route.change","actor":"hash:3f1b9c","actor_hint":"team=payments;role=admin","policy_version":"pv_42","diff":"+route A->B","auth_proof_ref":"sig_abc"}`
jeff: Ok let's review this Thursday 9am and lock the API shape.
